english.title: Environment Agency break up or open street without consent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the appropriate agency, without reasonable excuse

(A)_[broke up]_
(B)_[opened]_

a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..), where that street, not being a highway maintainable at public expense,

(C)_[was under the control or management of, or was maintainable by, a railway company,]_
(D)_[was under the control or management of, or was maintainable by, a navigation authority,]_
(E)_[formed part of a level crossing belonging to a railway company,]_
(F)_[formed part of a level crossing belonging to a navigation authority,]_
(G)_[formed part of a level crossing belonging to a person,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY, AUTHORITY OR PERSON..), without the consent of that

(H)_[company]_
(I)_[authority]_
(J)_[person]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 3(5) of Schedule 22 to the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being an appropriate agency,
without reasonable excuse
broke up or opened a street
where the street, not being a highway maintainable at public expense,
was under the control or management of, or was maintainable by, a railway company or navigation authority
OR formed part of a level crossing belonging to such a company or authority or other person,
without the consent of the company, authority or person to whom the crossing belonged
